findings.sourceQuote: separate admission checks from load-test evidence
findings.targetQuote: 受け入れ確認と負荷試験の証拠を区別します
findings.reason: 受け入れ確認 normally denotes acceptance checking. In this API-capacity context admission checks concern request admission, and should remain distinct from acceptance testing. The target makes that technical boundary ambiguous.
findings.suggestion: 10k RPSの境界を定め、例示の予算を計算し、リクエストの受付制御の確認と負荷試験の証拠を区別します。

de.result: No material translation issue found in the scoped strings. Version, final API status, illustrative budgets, and memory-layout non-guarantee are preserved.

findings.sourceQuote: separating scheduler behavior from throughput claims
findings.targetQuote: sans confondre comportement de l’ordonnanceur et débit
findings.reason: The source distinguishes observed scheduler behavior from claims about throughput; the target names throughput directly and drops the explicit status as a claim. No guarantee is added, but retaining this distinction better preserves the stated evidential boundary.
findings.suggestion: Observez le blocage des porteurs par les moniteurs dans JDK 21 et 25 avec JFR, en distinguant le comportement de l’ordonnanceur des affirmations sur le débit.

findings.targetQuote: aperçus; les aperçus tels que Valhalla
findings.reason: Aperçu can read as an overview rather than a pre-final feature status. Existing French intro already uses fonctionnalités en preview, which communicates the technical status more clearly.
findings.suggestion: Use « fonctionnalités en preview » consistently; for example « Guides JDK : API finalisées, vérifications du runtime et fonctionnalités en preview » and « distinguez les fonctionnalités en preview telles que Valhalla ».
